statements: Transaction details show the Transaction fee only for a sent transaction whose fee is not zero, and the Deposit only when the deposit is not zero. The Transaction ID is shown for every transaction.
Transaction metadata stays hidden until the user chooses to show unmoderated content.

A pending transaction's details offer cancellation once it has been pending for longer than the pending time limit, except while a wallet is being restored. Cancelling asks for confirmation; removing an expired transaction does not. Both delete the transaction from the wallet.
On a build without the CIP-30 dApp connector, a pending transaction is labelled Transaction pending and an expired one Transaction failed.
